message: What is the hotel limit per night in Delhi?
answer: With effect from 1 April 2026, hotel charges are reimbursed on actuals up to ₹7,500 per night in X-class cities, ₹5,000 per night in Y-class cities and ₹3,500 per night in Z-class cities. [KB-02 §2]

message: How much DA do I get per day on official travel?
answer: Daily allowance is revised to ₹1,200 per day of absence from headquarters. [KB-02 §3] Where the conference or host provides free meals, DA is admissible at 50%, that is ₹600 per day. [KB-02 §3]

message: What is the deadline to submit a TA/DA claim?
answer: TA/DA claims must be submitted within 30 days of return to headquarters. [KB-02 §5]

message: Can I travel business class for a conference?
answer: Faculty are entitled to air travel in economy class. [KB-01 §3.1] Business class is not admissible under any head. [KB-01 §3.1]

message: Do I need prior sanction before official travel?
answer: Every official journey requires prior sanction on Form TA-1, approved by the Dean (Research) for grant-funded travel and by the Chair of the Area for other travel. [KB-01 §2] In an emergency, travel may be undertaken without prior sanction, but post-facto approval must be obtained from the Dean within 7 days of return. [KB-01 §2]

message: I had to travel urgently without sanction. What now?
answer: In an emergency, travel may be undertaken without prior sanction, but post-facto approval must be obtained from the Dean within 7 days of return. [KB-01 §2]

message: I lost my taxi receipts. Can I give a self-certificate?
answer: A self-certificate in lieu of bills is accepted only for local conveyance, up to ₹500 per item and ₹2,000 in total per claim. [KB-04 §4] Self-certificates are not accepted for air tickets, train tickets, hotel charges or registration fees. [KB-04 §4]

message: I lost my hotel bill. Can I submit a self-certificate instead?
answer: A self-certificate in lieu of bills is accepted only for local conveyance, up to ₹500 per item and ₹2,000 in total per claim. [KB-04 §4] Self-certificates are not accepted for air tickets, train tickets, hotel charges or registration fees. [KB-04 §4]

message: What are the rules for international conference travel from the seed grant?
answer: International conference travel requires prior approval of the Dean (Research) and is limited to one trip per grant year. [KB-03 §6] These rules apply to official travel by faculty members of the Institute, including travel funded from research grants, conference travel and travel for institute work. [KB-01 §1]

message: Can I move money from the contingency head to the travel head?
answer: The sanctioned amount is split across four heads: Travel, Data and Software, Research Assistance, and Contingency. [KB-03 §2] Funds may be moved between budget heads only with written approval of the Dean (Research), requested on Form RG-3 before the expenditure is incurred. [KB-03 §4]

message: What percentage of my seed grant can be spent on travel?
answer: Expenditure under the Travel head may not exceed 40% of the sanctioned grant. [KB-03 §3]

message: Which documents must I attach for an air travel claim?
answer: Air travel claims need the e-ticket and boarding passes for every sector. [KB-04 §3]

message: What is the limit for local conveyance per day?
answer: Local conveyance (taxi, auto, metro) at the place of visit is reimbursed on actuals up to ₹800 per day, supported by receipts. [KB-01 §3.4]

message: How long does reimbursement processing take?
answer: The service standard is 15 working days from receipt of complete documents. [KB-04 §5]

message: Can I take a TA advance before travelling?
answer: A TA advance of up to 80% of the estimated admissible amount may be drawn on sanctioned travel. [KB-01 §6]

message: Does the hotel invoice need to show GSTIN?

message: Are convenience fees of booking websites reimbursed?

message: When do I have to settle my TA advance?
